title: A Pokémon has decided you're its trainer
dek: It followed you home, sat on your bag and refuses to leave. Twelve questions to work out which one you're now stuck with, and what that says about you.

questions.prompt: It sat on your bag and refused to move. What's in the bag?

options.label: Snacks, a charger, and a plan
Something broken you keep forgetting to fix
Fourteen hours of sleep debt
Something you'd rather nobody saw
Barks at a shadow and wakes the neighbour
Hums until somebody sings along
Sits very still, thinking about nothing
Steals something shiny and hides it

questions.prompt: The first battle it wins for you is against:

options.label: A stranger being rude to you
Your own to-do list
The cold
A bad mood, permanently

questions.prompt: A friend says your Pokémon is weird. You:

options.label: Agree. It's mostly asleep
Say 'that's the appeal' with too much feeling
Explain the theory that it's secretly a genius
Change the subject and check your wallet
On your feet, exactly where you need to walk
Across the doorway like a roadblock
On the warmest thing in the flat
Nowhere. It just stands there

questions.prompt: You're having a bad day. It responds by:

options.label: Sitting on your keyboard and looking worried
Turning off a light and pretending it was an accident
Singing something you didn't ask for
Bringing you a coin. It's your coin
Everything slightly rearranged, nothing broken
A prank you'll find in three days
Glitter. Somehow
Nothing. It watched you clean
Everyone mid-blink and slightly confused
One of you asleep, one of you holding the trophy
Warm, loud, and a little singed
Two looking at the camera, one at your wallet
The one that hits hardest
The one that never has to be told twice
Walk around calling its name like an idiot
Check the three places it always hides

questions.prompt: I do my best thinking while doing absolutely nothing.
I'd rather be liked than respected.

results.name: Eevee
results.blurb: You've got about six versions of yourself on standby and you keep almost becoming one of them. People find you easy to be around because you adapt fast, and then they're surprised when you're suddenly different. That's not indecision. That's range with a deadline problem.
strengths: Fits any room without losing yourself
Recovers from a bad week fast
results.watchOut: Choose a version of yourself and stay long enough to get good at it.

results.name: Psyduck
results.blurb: You are visibly going through something at all times and everyone can tell. The strange part is it works: you're more capable on your worst day than most people are on their best. You just have to survive the part where your brain loudly announces it's fine.
strengths: Performs under pressure nobody else would handle
No pretence about how you feel
results.watchOut: You don't have to wait until your head splits open to ask for help.

results.name: Snorlax
results.blurb: You are not lazy, you are running a strict energy budget. You'll sleep through the alarm, the argument and the apocalypse, then do more in forty minutes than the room did all day. Nobody gets to move you until you've decided to move.
results.watchOut: Rest is a strategy, not a hiding place. Set one thing in motion before the nap.

results.name: Gengar
results.blurb: You're the one who says the thing everyone was thinking, then watches the room rearrange itself. It's not cruelty — it's that you find pretence physically uncomfortable. Your pranks are affectionate. Your affection is also a bit of a prank.
results.watchOut: The bit lands until it doesn't. Check whether the person is still laughing.

results.name: Growlithe
results.blurb: You are all in, immediately, about everything. New hobby, new person, new cause — full commitment by Tuesday. It makes you the warmest person in the room and it also means you burn through things you liked a month ago.
results.watchOut: Not everything deserves the full flame on day one. Save some for month three.

results.name: Jigglypuff
results.tagline: Performing whether you asked or not
results.blurb: You've got a thing you do — a song, a story, a bit — and you'll do it for any room that's half-listening. You genuinely think you're being helpful. Sometimes you are. Sometimes everyone falls asleep and you're still going, marker in hand.
strengths: Turns a dull room into a moment
results.watchOut: Read the room before the second verse. Some silences are invitations.

results.name: Slowpoke
results.blurb: You process at half speed and arrive at answers everyone else missed. The lag looks like daydreaming; it's actually a very good filter. You're the only calm person in most situations, which makes you either deeply reassuring or deeply annoying.
results.watchOut: Some things are time-sensitive. Reply before the moment closes.

results.name: Meowth
results.blurb: You've always got an angle: a side plan, a slightly-too-clever trade, a way to make the boring part pay. You're not greedy so much as allergic to wasted effort. Ninety percent of your schemes are nonsense. The other ten percent actually work.
results.watchOut: Not everything is a trade. Some people are just being nice.
